description: A missing or blank field contributes nothing, and no separator.
A missing summary and lesson and an empty task ID: the summary is empty, and is still hashed.
Format characters (U+200B, U+FEFF) are not whitespace and are kept; a character outside the BMP is kept whole.
The model ID is inside the hash, as UTF-8: the same summary under another model hashes differently.

description: Longer than 8,192 UTF-16 code units: cut at 8,192.
Cut where the last kept unit is a high surrogate: that unit goes too, so no character is split (8,191 units).
Cut right after a space: the trailing space is dropped (8,191 units).
Cut inside a surrogate pair that follows a space: the high surrogate, then the space, are dropped (8,190 units).
